item.title: AHPRA loses in ruling on cosmetic nurse practitioners
item.description: A ruling in the Victorian Civil and Administrative Tribunal has confirmed that – contrary to AHPRA’s official position – registered nurses working in cosmetics can qualify as nurse practitioners. The post AHPRA loses in ruling on cosmetic nurse practitioners appeared first on Medical Republic.
